svg.aria-label: Three-step fix on a synthetic Meta CAPI payload. Step 1: capilinter inspect reports RAW_PII_UNHASHED_EMAIL, estimated match quality 1.0 out of 10, result FAIL. Step 2: capilinter hash normalizes and hashes the email. Step 3: the same payload with the hashed email has no errors, estimated match quality 4.0 out of 10, result PASS.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: CAPILINTER / FIX STORY

text.font-family: 'General Sans', 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One raw email fails the event. One hash fixes it.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: STEP 1 / 3

text.font-family: 'General Sans', 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The payload sends a raw email

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: $ capilinter inspect fixtures/unhashed_pii.json

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: [1/1] Lead event_id=demo_lead_2

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: × ERROR RAW_PII_UNHASHED_EMAIL: Found a raw email address. Normalize (trim, lowercase) and SHA-256

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: hash it.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: □ WARNING EVENT_TIME_STALE: 'event_time' is older than 7 days. Meta rejects the whole request if any

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: event in it is this old.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Estimated match quality: 1.0/10.0 (POOR)

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Matched: Client IP address, Client user agent

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: + Add a SHA-256 hashed, normalized email (+3.0).

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: + Add a SHA-256 hashed phone, digits with country code (+2.5).

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Result: FAIL

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: STEP 2 / 3

text.font-family: 'General Sans', 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Normalize and hash it the way Meta documents

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: $ capilinter hash Jane.Doe@Example.com

'Geist Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
